title_sq: 🏡 Shitet Vilë 4-Katëshe në Rezidencën Akacia Hills!
description_sq:

🛋️ Ambiente ndenjeje të bollshme dhe të mirëorganizuara

🍽️ Kuzhinë moderne e pajisur
🔥 Oxhak

title_en: 🏡 4-Storey Villa for sale in Acacia Hills Residence!
description_en: 🏡 4-Storey Villa for sale in Acacia Hills Residence! 📌 Premium location - elite, quiet and very safe area 💰 Price: Upon request ✨ The villa is divided into 2 duplexes, each with a separate entrance for maximum privacy. 🏠 Duplex 1 - Total area: 351 m² Organization & Features: 🛋️ Spacious and well-organized living spaces 🛏️ Bedrooms with dedicated wardrobes 🧖‍♀️ Sauna & hammam 🍽️ Modern equipped kitchen 🔥 Fireplace 🛗 Internal elevator ✔️ Included in the price: 🌿 Thermal facade + quality wood cladding 🪟 Double glazed duralumin windows 🪵 Wooden parquet throughout the villa 🚿 Complete toilets ❄️ Heating-cooling system with Chiller 🔔 Alarm system ☀️ Solar panels ✨ A luxury villa that offers comfort, elegance and privacy in every detail. Ideal for families looking for a quiet and high standard of living in one of the best residences in Tirana.
